RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel in economics often reflects existing departmental demographics rather than deliberate bias, though implicit bias or affinity bias remains possible. Furthermore, formal credentials do not fully capture departmental needs; the committee may have prioritized industry experience for specific applied curriculum requirements.

Whether to raise it depends on institutional policy. Review the university's hiring guidelines: if rules mandate gender diversity on search committees, you have legitimate procedural grounds to file an inquiry or appeal. If not, wait for written feedback before taking action. Raising allegations of discrimination based solely on committee composition is difficult to substantiate and carries significant professional risk without documented procedural violations or explicit evidence.
